claim: The historical 2026-10-04 foundation E2E covered 15 units and 80 slots through native executor observations, independent model review and 22 adjudications. Final labels are READY 18, PARTIAL 31, FAIL 2, BY_DESIGN 12 and INTERIM 17, with zero unjudged slots. Readiness is (18 + 12) / 80 = 37.5%, rounded half up to 38%; all 22 executor/reviewer disagreements were adjudicated, with 14 keeping the reviewer's status and 8 taking the executor's. This publication independently checks and sanitizes the retained status chains; it does not repeat host or provider execution. The adjudication prompt as run, claude-opus-5-5 at max effort with evidence-reviewer run records and timestamps, and the separate 33-slot fix list are retained.
limitations: Host state is as of 2026-10-04 19:10–20:10Z only; later adjudication and source merge timestamp 2026-10-04T20:26:16Z do not extend that observation window. Publication and repair perform artifact inspection and structural checks in the owned sandbox; they do not repeat native host probes.

Fixes are pending. The 33 PARTIAL/FAIL slots after adjudication are not accepted as ready: 25 repository-plan and 8 host fixes (evidence/artifacts/ns2604-e2e-20261004/fixes.json). Four INTERIM token slots (context-supply, command-output, output-compression, code-index) are held for PR #684, which has not merged. The two open token slots have separate fixes: ccusage (FAIL, plan) and statusline (PARTIAL, host).

This is not an upstream benchmark. Native executor observations, independent model judgments and adjudication are separate from upstream tests, structural checks, independent host replication and measured quality or token improvement.

The 17 INTERIM slots are held by design. They remain in the denominator and contribute zero to the readiness numerator; the 12 BY_DESIGN slots are intentional dispositions rather than proof that their tools executed.

Adjudication: claude-opus-5-5 at effort max (evidence-reviewer), prompt template as run in evidence/artifacts/ns2604-e2e-20261004/adjudication-prompt.md. Run wf_8bf450a9-d1e (17 agents) started 2026-10-04T20:06:45Z and completed 2026-10-04T20:20:30Z; run wf_cdbf70a0-02c (5 agents) started 2026-10-04T20:08:29Z and completed 2026-10-04T20:19:31Z.

Historical source command excerpts and raw conversations remain private. Public reasons are bounded to 60 words, fixes preserve the merge's 900-character bound before sanitization, and citations are limited to four per slot. Hashes establish byte identity, not success or adequacy of every native acceptance claim.

Reviewer records report the requested gateway model cx/gpt-6.1-sol-max and max effort; no resolved backend model identity is inferred. Independent model review is review of retained evidence, not independent execution on the host.

The coordinator registered all eight published files in manifests/evidence.json, and full repository validation passed at revision 92d182e7e. This bounded repair leaves that registry coordinator-owned; validation of the repaired working tree reports only hashes and mirrored claim/limitations pending synchronization. Per-file scans and local receipt tests are structural evidence only.
